metadata.title: Spleen
metadata.tagline: The listening diary with a soul
metadata.description: Rate, review and list your albums, EPs and tracks. Keep a listening diary and share your taste.

home.kicker: It's late, the city is asleep
home.title: What did you listen to tonight?
home.subtitle: Rate your records, keep a listening diary, put your favourite albums on your shelf. Gently.

album.reviewsEmpty: Nobody has written about this record yet. The first review is waiting for you.

list.descriptionHint: Optional. {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}.

list.orderHint: Use the arrows to move an item; each change is saved at once.

addTo.signIn: Sign in to keep this record in your lists.

stats.thisYearNote: Distinct records and tracks, dated listens.
stats.empty: Not enough listens for stats yet.
stats.decadesNote: By release year, in listens, all time.
stats.ratingsNote: The current rating of each record.
stats.totalNote: Distinct records and tracks, undated listens included.

notFound.quoteLine1: I am like the king of a rainy land,
notFound.quoteLine2: Rich, yet powerless, young and yet so very old…
notFound.attribution: Charles Baudelaire, “Spleen”, Les Fleurs du mal (1857)
notFound.body: This page got lost in the rain. The record you're looking for isn't on this shelf.

magicLink.subject: Your link to sign in to Spleen
magicLink.preview: One click, and the turntable spins again.
magicLink.body: Here is your link to sign in to Spleen. It is valid for 15 minutes and works only once.
magicLink.fallback: If the button does not work, paste this link into your browser:
magicLink.ignore: Did not ask for this? Just ignore this email.

suspension.subject: Your Spleen account is suspended
suspension.preview: The moderators suspended your account. Here is why.
suspension.body: Spleen's moderators suspended your account. You can no longer publish anything, and your reviews, lists and comments are hidden (they are not deleted).
suspension.rights: You can still sign in to read this reason, export your data or delete your account.
suspension.contest: To contest this decision, write to us at {email} and explain why: someone else will review your case.

auth.title: Step into the club
auth.subtitle: No password: we send you a magic link.
auth.sentBody: A link is on its way to {email}. It is valid for 15 minutes.
auth.devHint: In development, the link is printed in the server terminal.
auth.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
auth.error: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
auth.rateLimited: Too many requests at once. Wait a few minutes.

welcome.title: Welcome to the club
welcome.subtitle: Pick your @username: it is the address of your shelf.
welcome.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dots and underscores.
welcome.displayNameHint: You can change it whenever you like.
welcome.ageHint: This is the minimum age to use Spleen.

settings.title: Settings
settings.blindModeHint: Hides the community average until you have rated.
settings.avatarHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. We crop it to a square.
settings.usernameNote: One change every 30 days at most. Your former username stays reserved for 30 days, then it becomes free again.
settings.exportBody: A JSON file with everything Spleen keeps about you.
settings.deleteBody: Everything goes: profile, diary, reviews, lists and follows. This is permanent. Your username stays reserved for 30 days, with no link to you, then it becomes free again.
settings.blocksBody: Members you blocked can no longer follow you, like or comment on your reviews.

errors.USERNAME_COOLDOWN: You changed your username less than 30 days ago.
errors.AVATAR_TOO_LARGE: Image too large (1 MB at most).
errors.AVATAR_TYPE: This file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again a bit later.
errors.CATALOG_BUSY: MusicBrainz is very busy right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE: MusicBrainz is not answering. Try again a little later.
errors.CATALOG_NOT_FOUND: MusicBrainz does not know this record.
errors.ITEM_NOT_FOUND: This record is not (or no longer) in Spleen.
errors.MOOD_NOT_FOUND: One of the chosen moods no longer exists.
errors.TRACK_NOT_ON_RELEASE: This track is not on this record.
errors.DATE_REQUIRED: A dated listen keeps its date.
errors.SHELF_MISMATCH: Your shelf changed in the meantime: reload the page.
errors.SELF_ACTION: You can't do that with yourself.
errors.LIST_FULL: This list is full (250 items at most).
errors.LIST_ITEM_EXISTS: It is already in this list.
errors.LIST_MISMATCH: Your list changed in the meantime: reload the page.
errors.INVALID_CURSOR: This page no longer exists: reload the list.
errors.MODERATION_ACTION_INVALID: This action does not apply to this report.
errors.CANNOT_MODERATE_ADMIN: Admin accounts cannot be suspended from the site.

artist.pendingVisitor: Sign in to import the whole discography from MusicBrainz.

track.notOnRelease: This track is not on any record yet.

search.title: Search
search.prompt: Look for an album, an artist or a track.
search.empty: Nothing like that in Spleen yet.
search.remoteHint: The open music database Spleen's catalog comes from. A record is added once and for all.
search.remoteEmpty: MusicBrainz finds nothing either. Try another spelling.
search.signInToAdd: Sign in to add it to Spleen

listening.prompt: What did you listen to tonight?
listening.undatedHint: An undated listen counts for your rating, not your diary. Give it a date to add it there.
listening.moodsHint: {max, plural, one {# at most} other {# at most}}
listening.reviewHint: Your rating and your review are independent: one doesn't need the other.
listening.reviewExisting: A review is linked to this listen.
listening.tracksHint: Optional. Your album rating stays yours.
listening.blindHidden: Blind listening: the average shows up once you have rated.

shelf.subtitle: {name}'s 4 favourite records
shelf.pickHint: Pick a slot. If it is taken, the record in it goes back in the crate.
shelf.emptyHint: Pick your 4 favourite records: from a record's page or your hearts, “Put on my Shelf”.

social.blockBody: You will stop following each other. Neither of you will be able to like or comment on the other's reviews, and you will disappear from each other's feeds and notifications. {name} won't be told.
social.unblockBody: You will be able to follow and talk to each other again. Earlier follows don't come back.
social.reportThanks: Thank you. Moderators will take a look.

feed.title: Your feed
feed.popularHint: The most liked and commented reviews of the last 7 days, in {lang}.
feed.popularEmpty: No popular review this week yet. Write the first one?
feed.emptyBody: Follow a few members: their listens, reviews and hearts will settle in here, newest first.

comments.title: Comments
comments.empty: No comment yet. Start the conversation?
comments.label: Your comment
comments.remaining: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.unread: {count, plural, =0 {All read} one {# unread} other {# unread}}

moderation.delete: The moderators deleted {subject, select, review {your review} list {your list} comment {your comment} member {your account} other {your content}}.

blocks.title: Blocked members
blocks.intro: They can't follow you, like or comment on your reviews, and you no longer show up in each other's feeds and notifications. They are not told.

discover.title: Discover
discover.intro: What members listen to this week, recent releases, the top rated records and the reviews people talk about.
discover.trendsHint: The records the most members listened to in the last 7 days.
discover.trendsSwitchFr: See what French-speaking members listen to
discover.trendsSwitchEn: See what English-speaking members listen to
discover.filledAll: Few listens this week: the chart is completed with members of every language.
discover.filledMonth: Few listens yet: the chart is completed with the last 30 days.
discover.trendsEmpty: Not enough listens for a chart yet. Come back after a few evenings.
discover.recentHint: Albums and EPs out in the last 90 days.
discover.recentEmpty: No recent release in the catalog yet.
discover.topHint: At least {count} ratings per record. The score weighs the average by the number of ratings: a record rated 5 stars by a single person does not jump ahead of everyone.
discover.topEmpty: No record has enough ratings for this chart yet.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.effects: You can no longer publish anything. Your reviews, lists and comments are hidden: nobody sees them, but they are not deleted.
suspended.contestBody: Write to us at <email></email> and explain why. Someone else will review your case.
suspended.dataBody: You can download all your data, or delete your account for good.

admin.title: Moderation
admin.subtitle: Every decision keeps its reason and its author. The member concerned receives the reason.
admin.count: {count, plural, =0 {No reports} one {# report} other {# reports}}
admin.empty: Nothing to handle. The room is quiet tonight.
admin.others: {count, plural, one {# other open report on this content} other {# other open reports on this content}}
admin.reasonHint: Kept in the history and sent to the member concerned (except dismissals and catalog reports).
admin.doneEmailFailed: Done, but the email did not leave: the in-site notification remains.
admin.historyHint: A year after each decision, only its action, reason and category remain: links to people and the excerpt are erased.
admin.suspendHint: Without a report: keep it for obvious cases. Their content is hidden, not deleted, and an email gives them the reason.
